name: Myeloid inflammatory activation and respiratory burst control
rationale: Members cover myeloid (monocyte/macrophage/neutrophil) inflammatory activation via TLR and complement receptors, and unlike the neutrophil chemotaxis/degranulation confusables they centre on regulation of the NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and superoxide generation.

qualifier: netrin, ephrin and L1-family adhesion receptors
name: Axon guidance by netrin, ephrin and L1-family receptors
rationale: All members are axon guidance and fasciculation signals; the theme is distinguished from SLIT/ROBO and commissural-guidance confusables by netrin/DCC, EPH-ephrin, L1/CHL1 and DSCAM signaling.

qualifier: proximal second messengers and RAS activation
name: Proximal B cell receptor signaling to second messengers
rationale: Members describe BCR engagement, BTK, second-messenger generation, RAS activation and activation thresholds, distinguishing the theme from Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis and B cell differentiation/proliferation confusables.

core: B cell homeostasis and germinal center responses
name: Germinal center, memory and Tfh-supported B cell responses
rationale: Members concern germinal center formation, Tfh/ICOS and CD27 co-stimulation, memory B and T differentiation and B cell homeostasis, whereas confusables emphasize plasma cell differentiation, B cell proliferation and generic B cell signatures.

name: Renin-angiotensin and renal control of blood pressure
rationale: Members regulate systemic blood pressure and volume through angiotensin production and signaling, glomerular filtration, renal sodium and urine output and peptide catabolism, unlike confusables centred on NO-cGMP smooth-muscle tone or vasopressin water reabsorption.

name: Post-embryonic eye development with apoptotic vessel regression
rationale: Members concern post-embryonic eye development and apoptotic remodeling of blood vessels (as in hyaloid vessel regression), distinguishing the theme from embryonic eye-structure, cardiac and endothelial-differentiation confusables.

name: PDGF receptor signaling in fibroblast stromal activation
rationale: Members describe PDGF receptor alpha/beta signaling, receptor internalisation, fibroblast proliferation and mechanoresponsive stromal programmes, distinguishing the theme from ECM/EMT, Hippo-YAP and TGF-beta confusables that lack PDGF signaling.

name: Inner ear morphogenesis and vestibular gravity sensing
rationale: Members cover otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canal, otolith and sensory hair-cell development plus vestibular reflex and gravity response, unlike confusables on other cranial sensory organs and nerves or auditory hair-cell function.

name: Chromosome condensation and CENP-A centromere assembly
rationale: Members concern prophase/prometaphase chromosome condensation and CENP-A nucleosome deposition at centromeres, distinguishing the theme from cohesion, spindle, cytokinesis and nuclear-envelope confusables.

name: Glycosphingolipid and GPI anchor biosynthesis and transport
rationale: Members cover glycosphingolipid and GPI-anchor synthesis, glycolipid transfer and lipid-metabolic spastic paraplegia defects, distinguishing the theme from lysosomal glycosphingolipid catabolism, nucleotide-sugar transport and protein lipidation confusables.

name: Nuclear pore transport and SUMO conjugation cycle
rationale: Members span nuclear pore complex assembly and nucleocytoplasmic import/export together with SUMO processing, conjugation and desumoylation, so the theme differs from mRNA-export, nuclear-envelope-breakdown and SUMO-target confusables by combining both.

name: Dolichol lipid carrier biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern synthesis of dolichol/dolichyl phosphate and its oligosaccharide-linked form (including DHDDS deficiency), distinguishing the theme from GDP-mannose, dolichyl-phosphate-sugar and UDP-GlcNAc confusables.

qualifier: HR/NHEJ pathway choice, BRCA defects and ADP-ribosylation
name: Double-strand break repair, BRCA defects and ADP-ribosylation
rationale: Members cover sensing, resection and repair of double-strand breaks by HR, NHEJ, SSA and MMEJ, BRCA1/2-PALB2 defects and PARP-mediated ADP-ribosylation, unlike confusables centred on telomere maintenance, fork reversal or strand invasion.

name: RIG-I-like receptor signaling to NF-kB and its restraint
rationale: Members describe RIG-I/MDA5 sensing of dsRNA, NF-kB activation via TRAF6 and FADD/RIP1, and positive and negative regulation of this antiviral signaling, unlike confusables centred on IRF3/7 and type I interferon production.

name: G1/S control by RB1, CDK4/6 and cyclin turnover
rationale: Members concern RB1-E2F restraint, CDK4/6 and cyclin E-CDK2 activity and degradation of cyclin D and p27/p21 at G1/S, distinguishing the theme from E2F transcription and G2/M confusables.

name: IL-10 family, type III interferon and IL-12/IL-23 signaling
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-20-family and interferon-lambda signaling plus IL-12/IL-23 signaling, distinguished from confusables by the IL-10-family/type III interferon members and absence of IL-27/IL-35.

qualifier: restraint of angiogenic sprouting and junction control
name: Endothelial VEGFR2 and Tie2 signaling restraining angiogenic sprouting
rationale: Members describe VEGFR2 and Tie2 signaling, endothelial adherens junction control and negative regulation of sprouting, migration and proliferation, unlike the pro-angiogenic and VEGF-binding confusables.

name: Cytidine deamination for mRNA editing and antiviral restriction
rationale: All members involve APOBEC-type cytidine deamination, either C-to-U mRNA editing or restriction of viral and foreign nucleic acids, distinguishing the theme from viral replication, DNA demethylation and somatic hypermutation confusables.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor chemotaxis and degranulation
name: Neutrophil chemotaxis, formyl peptide receptor signaling and degranulation
rationale: Members concern myeloid inflammatory activation centred on neutrophil recruitment, formyl peptide receptor signaling and degranulation, unlike confusables on respiratory burst, extravasation or chemokine production.

name: MAPK negative feedback, ERK dephosphorylation and atypical MAPKs
rationale: Members describe phosphatase-mediated ERK inactivation, feedback suppression of MAPK signaling and atypical ERK5 and MAPK6/4 cascades, unlike confusables centred on RAS/RAF activation or AP-1, JNK and p38 output.

name: CHD-family chromatin remodeler complexes
rationale: Members concern CHD1/2, CHD6-9, NuRD and ChAHP remodeler complexes and the SNF2-family CSB, distinguishing the theme from BAF, HDAC and histone-methylation confusables.

qualifier: germline epigenetic and transposon silencing, maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Gametogenesis, fertilization and germline epigenetic reprogramming
rationale: Members cover sperm and oocyte formation, fertilization, piRNA and retroelement silencing, imprinting and the maternal-to-zygotic transition, unlike confusables centred on gonadal hormones, gonad development or meiotic recombination.

name: Hemidesmosome-basement membrane anchorage and epidermal cross-linking
rationale: Members describe laminin-integrin hemidesmosome and anchoring-fibril attachment of epithelium to basement membrane plus cornified envelope peptide cross-linking, unlike desmosome/cell-cell adhesion and collagen fibril confusables.

name: Tight junction regulation of endothelial and intestinal barriers
rationale: Members concern assembly, disassembly and localization at tight junctions and control of vascular, blood-brain and intestinal barrier permeability, unlike adherens junction, polarity and shear-stress confusables.

name: Senescence arrest with Polycomb silencing and secretory phenotype
rationale: Members describe oncogene-induced senescence, proliferative arrest, Polycomb-mediated repression and the SASP, distinguishing the theme from heterochromatin-focus and stress-induced senescence confusables.
